reader_usefulness.basis: Read the full task, effective requirements (no scope decisions), and every report line continuously in five consecutive ranges. For the intended pharmaceutical R&D, business-development and investment readers, the opening states the usable conclusion and the candidate–indication–formulation unit prevents phase labels from transferring to another program. The dated register supports navigation into the individual histories. Rentosertib observed versus imputed FVC denominators and REC-4881 safety versus efficacy populations remain visible beside their implications; discontinued programs retain their outcomes. The stage-aware table separates screening enrichment, candidate delivery, patient activity and clinical benefit rather than presenting a single success ranking. Partnership tables and subsequent examples connect data rights, experimental responsibility, handoff and contingent payments to practical diligence questions. The final recommendations are conditional on the actual deliverable and next uncertainty, with clinical and disclosure limits preserved. No concrete understanding or decision obstacle requiring revision was found. This reader-usefulness assessment checks the supplied text and citation presentation, not independent re-verification of the clinical or contractual source record.
